title: fix: log sandboxes in without the keys permission
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: New `pollinations` and `pollinations-large` sandboxes log in with `profile`, `usage` and `machines` permissions, without `keys`. When that login cannot create keys, `resolveHarnessKey` uses the sandbox login for harnesses and checks its permissions through `/account/key`. On macOS, `polli auth login` still requests `keys`, so harnesses continue to use separate `polli-harness-*` keys. The PR also updates sandbox documentation and the harness script comment, and bumps `polli` to 0.1.42.
